name: Outdoor Fund Local Impact Grants

funder.name: Bass Pro Shops and Cabela's Outdoor Fund

summary: Small rolling grants for nonprofits and public bodies in the US and Canada running specific wildlife and habitat conservation projects near Bass Pro Shops and Cabela's stores. No operating costs, construction or projects still in design.

geography.label: United States and Canada, near retail locations

eligibility.rule: US: municipality, public body or IRS 501(c); Canada: registered nonprofit, municipality, public body or CRA charity
Request a specific project, program or community event focused on a listed conservation pillar
No fundraising, giveaway, operating, capital/endowment, construction, development-phase, ATV/UTV or boat requests

status.quote: Guidelines: Application Timeline: Rolling Requested Grant Amount: Up to $5,000.

applicant_types.quote: Organization Eligibility U.S: Must be a municipality, public institution, or registered with the IRS as a 501(c)(3) or other 501(c) determination.

geography.quote: Must be a municipality, public institution, or registered with the IRS as a 501(c)(3) or other 501(c) determination. Organization Eligibility Canada: Must be a provincially registered nonprofit

access.quote: Supporting local organizations and projects that engage communities near our retail locations and align with our conservation pillars of Conserving Wildlife and Habitat and Connecting New Audiences to the Outdoors. Apply Now

window.quote: Guidelines: Application Timeline: Rolling Requested Grant Amount: Up to $5,000.

amount.quote: Guidelines: Application Timeline: Rolling Requested Grant Amount: Up to $5,000.

eligibility.quote: Organization Eligibility U.S: Must be a municipality, public institution, or registered with the IRS as a 501(c)(3) or other 501(c) determination. Organization Eligibility Canada: Must be a provincially registered nonprofit, municipality, public institution, or an organization registered as having charitable status by the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA).

Request must be for a specific project, program, or community event that is focused on one of our key conservation pillars of Conserving Wildlife and Habitat or Connecting New Audiences to the Outdoors.

The Outdoor Fund does not support fundraising events, banquets, and/or items to be given away to participants, general operating support, capital campaigns or endowments, construction and building costs, projects that are in the design or development phase, ATV/UTV and boat requests.
